description: Declares event flags by name: a flag is one yes/no fact of the story that the save keeps ("this pickup was taken", "this door is open", "this cutscene was seen"). Scripts test and set them with sh.flag_get / sh.flag_set, map data (events, world objects, spawn rules, the paper map) names them the same way, and a save stores the names of the flags that are set. Each entry: "description" says what sets the flag and what it changes; "aliases" are former names that still resolve everywhere (old saves, scripts and mods); "old_save_names" are former names that now name another flag, so they are read only from saves written before the rename. The engine gives every flag its save bit itself (the original layout of the base flags is the "event_flags" list of original_order.json). A mod adds its own flags with a flags.json or flags/*.json of the same shape in its folder (names are then <mod folder>:Name). Event flags of map2: the streets of Old Silent Hill (map2_s00), the church (map2_s01), the streets of Central Silent Hill (map2_s02) and the police station (map2_s04): pickups, notes, doors and cutscenes.

M2S00_WaterWorksCutscene.description: Set at the end of the short scene at the water works in the Old Silent Hill streets (map2_s00, event 37), which plays after M2S02_LeftForWaterWorks: the paper map, then a view of the water works. Until it is set after leaving for the water works, no enemies spawn in map2_s00.

M2S00_UnlockedKatanaRoom.description: Unlocks thew Katana room inside the Levin Street house.

M2S00_UsedGasolineOnChainsaw.description: Set when the gasoline tank is used on the chainsaw in the Old Silent Hill streets (map2_s00, event 192, "Used the gasoline."). It enables the chainsaw pickup; the results screen reads it and carries it into the next game, so the chainsaw stays fueled.

M2S00_PickupChainsaw.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the chainsaw on map2_s00 (Old Silent Hill - streets) at map point 133 (x -82.0, z -91.0 m), event 191; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M2S00_PickupRockDrill.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the rock drill on map2_s00 (Old Silent Hill - streets) at map point 131 (x 236.6, z 345.5 m), event 185; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M2S00_ChainsawNotTaken.description: Mirror of 'chainsaw not taken yet', refreshed every frame while Harry is in the shop cells (13..14, 13). Enables the 'There is a Chainsaw.' message at map point 133.

M2S00_RockDrillNotTaken.description: Mirror of 'rock drill not taken yet', refreshed every frame while Harry is in the cell (22, 25). Enables the 'There is a Rock drill.' messages at map points 131/132.

M2S04_SeenPoliceChalkboard.description: Set when Harry reads the chalkboard in the police station (map2_s04). Together with M4S01_InspectedChalice it unlocks the botany book in Nowhere (M7S00_BotanyBookReadable, set when the Nowhere hospital map7_s00 loads).

M2S00_CafeExitCutsceneSeen.description: Set when the scene of leaving the cafe starts (camera at the cafe door, town map). Until then Old Town spawns no street monsters; the cafe music uses its early mix.

M2S00_NoteToSchoolFound.description: Set when Harry finds Cheryl's sketchbook page 'To school' in the Old Town alley (the school gets marked on the map). Also set on entering the school, which removes the note from the inventory.

M2S00_DogHouseNoteFound.description: Set when Harry reads the note on the doghouse on Levin St. in Old Silent Hill (map2_s00, events 52-55); the note is added to the inventory. It enables taking the house key from the doghouse (event 57) and hides the note world objects.

M2S00_PickupDogHouseKey.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the dog house key on map2_s00 (Old Silent Hill - streets) at map point 16 (x -139.1, z 53.2 m), event 57; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M2S00_PickupKeyOfLion.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the key of lion on map2_s00 (Old Silent Hill - streets) at map point 17 (x 185.2, z 116.1 m), event 59; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M2S00_PickupKeyOfWoodman.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the key of woodman on map2_s00 (Old Silent Hill - streets) at map point 18 (x -190.5, z 376.6 m), event 60; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M2S00_PickupKeyOfScarecrow.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the key of scarecrow on map2_s00 (Old Silent Hill - streets) at map point 19 (x 99.9, z -33.1 m), event 61; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M2S00_HouseKeyUsed.description: Set when the House Key (from the doghouse) is used on the door at (-142.8, 51) ('Used the House Key.'); the door then leads inside.

M2S00_LockOfLionOpen.description: Set when the Key of Lion is used on its lock of the Door of Eclipse in Old Silent Hill (map2_s00). It removes that lock's model, changes the lock picture, and counts toward opening the door (M2S00_DoorOfEclypseOpen).

M2S00_LockOfWoodmanOpen.description: Set when the Key of Woodman is used on its lock of the Door of Eclipse in Old Silent Hill (map2_s00). It removes that lock's model, changes the lock picture, and counts toward opening the door (M2S00_DoorOfEclypseOpen).

M2S00_LockOfScarecrowOpen.description: Set when the Key of Scarecrow is used on its lock of the Door of Eclipse in Old Silent Hill (map2_s00). It removes that lock's model, changes the lock picture, and counts toward opening the door (M2S00_DoorOfEclypseOpen).

M2S00_DoorOfEclypseOpen.description: Set when the last of the three locks on the Door of Eclipse (the Levin St. house in Old Silent Hill, map2_s00) is opened ("It's unlocked."). It enables walking through the door (event 72) and marks the doghouse with arrows on the map.

M2S00_DoorOfEclipsePassed.description: Set when Harry goes through the opened Door of Eclipse (room load at map point 24); triggers the darkness scene.

M2S00_DarknessFell.description: Set at the end of the scene behind the Door of Eclipse ('What? It's getting dark again?'). Old Town (and the cafe, map0_s02) stay dark until M1S06_WokeUpAfterBoss; the door at points 24/25 becomes a normal passage.

M2S00_PickupSteelPipe.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the steel pipe on map2_s00 (Old Silent Hill - streets) at map point 2 (x -187.6, z 300.3 m), event 43; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M2S00_KGordonDoorOpen.description: Set when the K. Gordon key is used on the K. Gordon house door in Old Silent Hill (map2_s00, events 94/95). It updates the map mark, makes the school entrances say there is no reason to search the school any more, and stops a set of the map's enemy-state bits from being cleared on load.

M2S00_AtBridgeControlDoor.description: Set silently when Harry steps on the spot (197, -91.9) by the door near the drawbridge, cleared when he walks east past x 198. While set, the door at (194, -94) to the bridge control room (and back) works and the street collision changes.

M2S00_DrawbridgeKeyUsed.description: Set when the Drawbridge Key is used on the control panel and the switch is pressed: the machinery runs (motor hum in the control room and by the bridge).

M2S00_DrawbridgeOperated.description: Set (with M2S00_DrawbridgeLowered) when the drawbridge has come down. The panel then says 'The drawbridge is operating.' and the music of room 33 changes.

M2S00_DrawbridgeLowered.description: Set when the drawbridge has come down: on later loads the bridge is drawn down and its raised-half collision is off.

M2S00_WornPadlockInspected.description: Set after the scene 'Hmm... the lock is worn out.' at the chained door (-262, -104). From then on Harry's attacks can break the padlock.

M2S00_PadlockBroken.description: Set when Harry breaks the worn padlock. The door is left ajar and the swinging-door scene follows.

M2S00_ChainedDoorSwungOpen.description: Set in the swinging-door scene after the padlock is broken: the chains are drawn broken and the door can be used.

M2S00_ChainedDoorPassed.description: Set when Harry first goes through the opened chained door (-262.5, -104); the chains are no longer drawn and the door works both ways.

M2S00_StreetSpawnCafe.description: One of three exclusive flags choosing the Old Town street monster table: the streets around the cafe (default at the start). Set by trigger zones at (125, 217) or by default.

M2S00_StreetSpawnSchool.description: Street monster table flag: the west strip towards the school (replaced by the church table after Split Head until the church scene). Set by trigger zones at (114, 217)/(114, 297).

M2S00_StreetSpawnChurch.description: Street monster table flag: the sparse table around the church. Set by the trigger zone at (125, 297).

M2S00_PickupHealthDrink.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the health drink on map2_s00 (Old Silent Hill - streets) at map point 67 (x -12.0, z 205.0 m), event 143; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M2S01_FlaurosOnTable.description: Set when Dahlia puts the Flauros down during the church scene (her animation frames 21..30, or at the scene's end). The Flauros model appears and can be taken.

M2S01_PickupFlauros.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the flauros on map2_s01 (Church) at map point 1 (x 19.8, z 23.9 m), event 3; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M2S01_PickupDrawbridgeKey.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the drawbridge key on map2_s01 (Church) at map point 1 (x 19.8, z 23.9 m), event 4; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M2S01_DahliaCutsceneDone.description: Set at the end of the Dahlia scene in the church; the hospital is circled on both town maps.

M2S01_ChurchDoorTried.description: Set by the first try of the church door at map point 2 (12, 24) ('Locked.'); later tries say 'It won't open.'.

M2S01_ChurchFmvSeen.description: Set after the FMV on entering the church (file XA/M6_02112); then the Dahlia scene runs. Also switches Old Town to its later ambience and ends the church street monster table.

M2S01_DahliaCutsceneStarted.description: Set when the Dahlia scene starts in the church; the music of the church room switches to its full layers.

M2S00_UsedGasolineOnRockDrill.description: Set when the gasoline tank is used on the rock drill in the Old Silent Hill streets (map2_s00, events 187/188, "Used the gasoline."). It enables the rock drill pickup; the results screen reads it and carries it into the next game, so the drill stays fueled.

M2S02_AmbienceRestoredAfterOtherworld.description: Set by the tick event that waits for the street ambience to load (and fades in) after Harry is back in Central Silent Hill from the Otherworld. Nothing else reads it.

M2S02_AntiqueShopOpen.description: Set when the antique shop key is used on the Green Lion Antiques door in Central Silent Hill (map2_s02, events 9/10). It enables the door into the shop (event 11, map transition) and stops the extra music layer that plays while the key is carried but the shop is still closed.

M2S02_BackFromOtherworld.description: Set by the arrival scene in Central Silent Hill after the Otherworld/Floatstinger part (screen fades in, drone stops, flashlight off). Arms the arrival events of the streets (to Old Town, room load at (-115.5, 107.5)).

M2S02_KaufmannShotsHeard.description: Set after the two gunshots near (-100, -108) have played as Harry approached (-96, -89) in Central Silent Hill; they do not play again.

M2S02_LeftForWaterWorks.description: Set when Harry, after the darkness event of map2_s02 (M2S02_BackFromOtherworld), leaves through the exit at map2_s02 point 24 to the Old Town streets (map2_s00, arrival point 33). It starts the map2_s00 water works scene (event 37, MapEvent_AtWaterWorks: 'This must be that water works Lisa was talking about') and, until that scene has played, map2_s00 spawns no enemies.

M2S02_PassageAfterDarknessCrossed.description: After the darkness event (M2S02_BackFromOtherworld), set the first time Harry crosses the map2_s02 passage at point 29 (room warp to point 30, no fade-in) or the room's spawn pass runs (which also restarts the ambient sounds). Until it is set the screen fades back in gradually while he walks there (x > -116 m). It gates map2_s02 event 30 (MapEvent_RoomEnterAmbientWait), which waits for the ambient sounds and sets M2S02_AmbienceRestoredAfterOtherworld.
